coding_rules.unit: A named property and inspected configuration within a broad dimension; codes are indices to notes, not whole-dimension judgments or ordinal scores.
coding_rules.runtime: E requires an identifiable timing comparison, cost profile, configuration experiment, or repeated/averaged measurement. Isolated approximate stage duration or throughput reports are C. Preserve the original value, interval, and hardware, without assuming an unreported measurement occurred or did not occur.
coding_rules.control: Text/image adherence, camera/hand pose accuracy, and explicitly measured agency can qualify for E under their named constructs. General satisfaction, creativity support, and affective dominance alone do not establish generation control.
coding_rules.implementation: Versioned official export code can supply D for implementation. Static code inspection does not imply model execution, output validation, or successful engine/headset use.
coding_rules.mixed_evidence: When a broad cell contains a measured component and a separate claim, the note records both scopes; an E for the component does not validate the separate claim.
coding_rules.temporal_applicability: Name the temporal target before assigning a code: object evolution, ordered-view coherence, revisiting, or retained modification. Static representation does not imply NA when a path or revisit protocol is examined. NA for a standalone static output refers only to temporal content/state generation; persistence relevant to an editing/streaming system but unexamined is NR. Spatial/path entries can index the same observation and are not independent tests.
